name: RuNames-reforged
title: RuNames Reforged
author: FactorioParanoidal, GotLag, nastyslave
description: Russian names for train stops, locomotives, labs, radars and roboports from 11 name sets, toggled in map settings. Ctrl+N gives the building under the cursor a random name, Ctrl+R opens the rename window. Replaces Name Lists, Russian Station Names and Renamer.
